On the triangle complex an exact residual is never an open residual (not LGGR), as exactness implies cocycle and so closed rather than open.

near_misses.claim: An exact residual on the triangle is LGGR.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Exact means w is a coboundary, so it is globally red-resolvable; LGGR requires closed but not exact.

near_misses.claim: A non-cocycle (open) residual on the triangle is LGGR.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: LGGR requires d1 w = 0 everywhere; open residual has a nonzero plaquette.
